borderline_drops.title: Oracle July 2026 Critical Patch Update (1,449 patches, three CVSS 9.9 unauth RCEs)
borderline_drops.reason: Routine quarterly patch cadence (PD-11b): a scheduled CPU is the regular patch cycle by definition. No confirmed in-the-wild exploitation of the new CVEs; the 'actively exploited PeopleSoft' angle traces to a 2026-06-12 KEV addition (old). No public PoC / verified scanning on the new CVEs → does not meet the imminent-mass-exploitation trigger. National-CERT flagging does not override (PD-13). CVSS 9+ alone is insufficient. Recoverable: readers running Oracle Database/Commerce/TimesTen should prioritise the CVSS 9.9 entries (CVE-2026-61211, -60402, -61146) inside their normal CPU processing.

borderline_drops.title: Veeam Appliances Updater LPE (CVE-2026-56844, CVSS 8.4)
borderline_drops.reason: Local-authenticated-only prerequisite (no remote/network vector), no confirmed exploitation, no public PoC. Does not require an out-of-band response beyond the regular patch cycle (PD-11b). Veeam's status as a ransomware target is a standing fact, not an in-window trigger.

borderline_drops.title: Germany 'CyberGovSecure' mandatory federal cybersecurity governance (cabinet decision)
borderline_drops.reason: Governance/policy development, not an attacker-TTP or operational item — a Swiss SOC does not patch/hunt/detect differently in the next 7 days because of it (fails the borderline-include test). Single-source (DPA-wire-derived). Belongs to the weekly strategic lens (W2), not the operational intel run (PD-8 division of labour). Flagged for the next weekly run's consideration.
